newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Lack of supply bolsters Hungary's Pick.
newsitem.headline: Lack of supply bolsters Hungary's Pick.

text.p: Shares in Hungary's meat processor Pick Szeged Rt outperformed most of the market in early trading on Friday and rose more than three percent through a lack of liquidity owing to weak supply, traders said.
"Pick's market is completely illiquid and a bigger order on either side could substantially move the market," one trader said.
Pick shares opened at 11,005 forints, above Thursday's close of 10,955 and at 1112 GMT they traded at 11,300 forints, with less than 3,000 shares having changed hands.
While Pick had no sellers at current prices, holders of its stocks seemed to be unloading their papers at 11,400 forints, he said.
